records.context: A mysterious older man gets Cristina Erneco's attention and says she reminds him of a formidable woman pirate from the past. She asks whether they look alike;he corrects this to a similar air,perhaps because Cristina too looks strong. Her upbeat resolve to get even stronger prompts his suggestion to seek that pirate's prized sword. He reports the pirate's use of it but does not know its worth. Cristina asks where;he names the Caribbean and she echoes it. He recounts a great naval battle there,in which the pirate participated,and hearsay that she lost the sword during the fighting. And? receives only That's all. Cristina challenges the inadequate lead. He cannot give a method but feels she could find it. She agrees only to keep it in mind;he encourages her,and she thanks him. A separate parenthesized thought recalls the lost sword and her wish to see it. A portraitless,null-actor FE notice then states Cristina: Charm +1!,preserving the exact literal character,actual Charm attribute label and one-point amount. No pirate identity,red-hair epithet,death,nationality,rank,kinship,particular island/wreck,magic,attack value,royal provenance,guaranteed search/find,acquired sword or mechanical sword effect is invented.
